Simulated data. Location is faked in this preview and streams one fix per second, like a phone. After a big jump the app needs about 3 fixes to settle, because it shows the median of the last 5. Real GPS, HOLD timing and SCREEN ON only behave for real on the phone after push. Presets are sample coordinates and altitudes for testing layout, not surveyed values. Place names come from the offline data bundled with this version.
